title: Quasi-coherence after open restriction
statement: Restricted stage and limit objects are quasi-coherent

proof.text: For each stage and for the apex, apply schemeDerivedQCoh_openRestriction_iff and use quasi-coherence of the corresponding cohomology sheaf over the open.

mathlib_searches.query: existence and compatibility of restricted representing derived pullback Hom cocone

lean.statement: theorem perfect_hom_open_restricted_qcoh {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) {i : I} {Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] (B : Y.Opens) (Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (d : Cocone F) (h : PerfectHomPushPullData R c s Q F d) : (∀ j : Set.Ici i, schemeDerivedQCohProperty B.toScheme ((F ⋙ schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj j)) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty B.toScheme ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj d.pt)
